notes.TabPFN-v2: Frozen pretrained checkpoint; CPU inference; no downstream fine-tuning.
notes.TabICLv2: Frozen pretrained checkpoint; CPU inference; no downstream fine-tuning.
notes.TabDPT: Used as the replacement for Mitra due to local compatibility and computational constraints. Frozen pretrained weights; no downstream fine-tuning. AutoGluon uses the installed tabdpt package default weights.
notes.CatBoost: Mandatory gradient-boosted tree baseline trained on the downstream training split.
notes.MLP: Mandatory neural baseline trained on the downstream training split with validation-based early stopping.

TabDPT.loading_method: Default weights provided by the installed tabdpt package; AutoGluon model_weight_path is not explicitly set.
